user_input: Let's upgrade AIRLINE NEXUS into a premium, ultra-fast, intelligent airline booking platform with smooth animations, modern features, and reliable real-time functionality. Improve the existing repository, preserve the React + Express + Spring Boot + Python FastAPI + MySQL + Redis architecture, preserve existing APIs/database/authentication/booking/payment/search/seat/admin functionality, and implement and test the prioritized improvements in the actual source code.
title: Airline Nexus premium platform upgrade

assessment_snapshot.intro: The repository is a brownfield full-stack airline booking platform with a React/Tailwind frontend, Node/Express gateway, multiple Java/Spring services, a Python/FastAPI AI service, MySQL, Redis, Docker configuration, and existing audit/architecture artifacts.
bullets: Frontend, gateway, Java backend services, AI service, and Docker Compose are present.
The requested work is an in-place upgrade, not a rewrite, and explicitly requires existing APIs, database schema, authentication, booking, payment, seat, and admin behavior to remain compatible.
The brief prioritizes bug/API performance fixes, loading and UX improvements, database/Redis reliability, premium UI, live tracking, AI integration, and admin capabilities.
No current-UI screenshot set, exact target library, exact framework versions, external flight-status provider, or payment/email provider is specified.

proposed_outcome: Incrementally upgrade the existing Airline Nexus codebase in place, preserving observable contracts and transactional behavior while delivering measured performance improvements, accessible premium UX, reliable real-time capabilities, verified AI assistance, and regression-tested operational features.
